sentences: For our English club, Mina and I designed a board game about a small town.
Each player start at the station and follows a different route.
We wrote the rules clear and put a copy beside each board.
Before the first test, our teacher asked us check the map for missing street names.
A pupil who knew the town very well give us two useful suggestion.
We listened to her and added a bridge which connect the two sides of the river.
The new route was much more shorter than the old one.
After play one complete game, we asked the group what they wanted to change.
They all agreed that one card had too many information on it.
We removed a repeated sentence from the card and tested the game again, which made the instructions more easier to follow.

review_response_tasks.rationale: bridge为单数，当前地图关系用connects；依过去叙事时点描述连接的桥也可用connected。两种已核时态同等接受。

review_response_tasks.stem: 修改记录7（任选错误，顺序不限）
review_response_tasks.rationale: much可加强比较级shorter，more重复比较，删more。若提出其他修法，未列者待复核。

review_response_tasks.rationale: After介词后用playing；本题每处仅一词，不能一次写having played。

corrected_passage_variants: For our English club, Mina and I designed a board game about a small town. Each player starts at the station and follows a different route. We wrote the rules clearly and put a copy beside each board. Before the first test, our teacher asked us to check the map for missing street names. A pupil who knew the town very well gave us two useful suggestions. We listened to her and added a bridge which connects the two sides of the river. The new route was much shorter than the old one. After playing one complete game, we asked the group what they wanted to change. They all agreed that one card had too much information on it. We removed a repeated sentence from the card and tested the game again, which made the instructions easier to follow.
